specification.text:
schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
}

interface IValidationError {
  message: String!
  fieldPath: [String!]!
}

interface RiskSubmissionAnswer {
  question(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String!
  comment(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String
  notApplicable: Boolean
}

interface ScoredRiskSubmissionAnswer implements RiskSubmissionAnswer {
  score: Int
  question(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String!
  comment(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String
  notApplicable: Boolean
}

interface ScreeningSource {
  name: String!
  types: [String!]!
  countryCodes: [String!]!
  url: String
  startedDate: Date
  endedDate: Date
}

interface SecurityTimelineItem {
  actor: Actor
  timestamp: DateTime!
  ipAddress: String
  type: SecurityTimelineItemType!
}

type Actor {
  actorId: String!
  name: String!
}

type AddEntityDocumentFileResult {
  file: DocumentInformation!
  uploadUrl: URL!
}

type AddIndividualDocumentFileResult {
  file: IndividualDocumentFile!
  uploadUrl: URL!
}

type Address {
  "Line 1 of the address"
  address1: String
  "Line 2 of the address"
  address2: String
  city: String
  region: String
  postCode: String
  country: CountryInformation
}

type AddressRiskSubmissionAnswer implements ScoredRiskSubmissionAnswer & RiskSubmissionAnswer {
  question(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String!
  comment(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String
  notApplicable: Boolean
  address: Address
  score: Int
}

type AdverseMediaItem {
  "Date of the article"
  date: DateTime
  "Title of the article"
  title: String!
  "URL of the article"
  url: String
  "Relevant snippet from the article"
  snippet: String
}

type AdverseMediaScreeningAdditionalData {
  "Countries associated with the adverse media match"
  countries: [String!]!
  "Subtypes of the adverse media match"
  subtypes: [String!]!
}

type AdverseMediaScreeningSource implements ScreeningSource {
  "The name of the source"
  name: String!
  "The types and subtypes of the adverse media match"
  types: [String!]!
  "The country codes associated with the adverse media match"
  countryCodes: [String!]!
  "Source URL"
  url: String
  startedDate: Date
  endedDate: Date
  "Additional data specific to adverse media sources"
  additionalData: AdverseMediaScreeningAdditionalData!
  "The articles contributing to the adverse media match"
  items: [AdverseMediaItem!]!
}

type AmlProfile {
  "Description of the captured activity"
  capturedActivity: String
  "Description of the purpose of the activity"
  purpose: String
  "Description of the nature of the activity"
  nature: String
  cddLevel: CddLevel
  "Latest case risk assessment level"
  riskAssessment: RiskAssessment
  "Latest client risk assessment level"
  clientRiskAssessment: RiskAssessment @cost(weight: "10")
  "Value of the transaction"
  transactionValue: Decimal
}

type ApiClientMetadata {
  "The details of an organization that the currently authenticated API client can access, identified by the provided organizationId."
  organization(organizationId: String!): Organization
  "The list of organizations the currently authenticated API client can access"
  accessibleOrganizations: [Organization!]!
  "The unique identifier of the currently authenticated API client"
  apiClientId: String!
  "The set of scopes granted to the current API client"
  scopes: [String!]!
  "Friendly name associated with the API client (displayed in activity logs and other places where the API client makes changes to data)"
  friendlyApiClientName: String
}

type AuthenticationSecurityTimelineItem implements SecurityTimelineItem {
  actor: Actor @cost(weight: "10")
  userEmail: String
  description: String
  connectionName: String
  type: SecurityTimelineItemType!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  ipAddress: String
}

type AutoAnswerEvidence {
  status: AutoAnswerEvidenceStatus!
  "Version of the high-risk jurisdiction list the answer was checked against. Null for other questions"
  listVersion: String
}

type CaseDetails {
  caseRequestor: ContactInfo
  caseLead: ContactInfo
}

type CaseDisbursementSummary {
  amount: Decimal!
  calculatedAt: DateTime!
  totalUnits: Decimal!
}

type CaseDocumentInformation {
  "Type of the document"
  type: CaseDocumentType!
  "Unique identifier for the document"
  documentId: String!
  "The individual files that support this document"
  files: [DocumentInformation!]!
}

type CaseDocumentSecurityTimelineItem implements SecurityTimelineItem {
  actor: Actor @cost(weight: "10")
  documentId: String
  caseId: String!
  type: SecurityTimelineItemType!
  accessMethod: DocumentAccessMethod
  timestamp: DateTime!
  ipAddress: String
}

type CaseEntity {
  "Unique identifier of the entity"
  entityId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Type of the entity"
  entityType: EntityType @cost(weight: "10")
  "Legal name of the entity"
  legalName: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "The legal unique identifier for this entity. e.g. for a NZ company this would be the NZ company number"
  identifier: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "Notes about this entity (notes may include html formatting)"
  notes: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "Notes about the source of wealth (notes may include html formatting)"
  sourceOfWealthNotes: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "Address details of the entity"
  address: Address @cost(weight: "10")
  "The country the entity is registered in"
  registeredCountry: CountryInformation @cost(weight: "10")
  "The registration authority the entity is registered in"
  registrationAuthorityCode: RegistrationAuthorityCode @cost(weight: "10")
  documents: [EntityDocumentInformation!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  verificationCheckStatus: EntityVerificationStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  exception: EntityExceptionDetails @cost(weight: "10")
  "The urls to First AML applications for the entity"
  urls: EntityUrls! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The most recent verification report available for the entity"
  latestVerificationReport: EntityVerificationReport @cost(weight: "10")
}

type CaseIndividual {
  "Unique identifier of an individual"
  individualId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Date of birth of the individual"
  dateOfBirth: Date @cost(weight: "10")
  "Preferred name of the individual"
  preferredName: PersonName! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Legal name of the individual"
  legalName: PersonName! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Email address of the individual"
  emailAddress: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "Phone number of the individual"
  phoneNumber: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "Phone number of the individual in E.164 format"
  standardizedPhoneNumber: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "Does this individual require CDD"
  requiresCDD: Boolean!
  "Is this individual a contact for the case?"
  isCaseContact: Boolean!
  "Address details of the individual"
  address: Address! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Notes about this individual (notes may include html formatting)"
  notes: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "The country of citizenship for this individual"
  citizenship: CountryInformation @cost(weight: "10")
  "The status of verifications for this individual"
  individualVerificationChecksStatus: IndividualVerificationCheckStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The documents associated with this individual"
  documents: [IndividualDocumentInformation!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The exception associated with this individual and case"
  exception: IndividualExceptionDetails @cost(weight: "10")
  "Notes about the individual's source of wealth (notes may include html formatting)"
  sourceOfWealthNotes: String @cost(weight: "10")
  "The urls to First AML applications for the individual"
  urls: IndividualUrls! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The most recent verification report available for the individual"
  latestVerificationReport: IndividualVerificationReport @cost(weight: "10")
  "The verification type for this individual"
  individualVerificationType: IndividualVerificationType! @cost(weight: "10")
}

type CaseInformation {
  caseId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  name: String
  caseStatus: CaseStatus!
  organization: Organization! @cost(weight: "10")
  office: Office @cost(weight: "10")
  lastUpdatedOn: DateTime!
  createdOn: DateTime!
  timeReceived: DateTime!
  reference: String
  notes(includeHtml: Boolean = true): String
  caseType: CaseType! @cost(weight: "10")
  amlProfile: AmlProfile! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Case details for this case"
  caseDetails: CaseDetails! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The list of documents associated directly to the case"
  documents: [CaseDocumentInformation!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The list of individuals in this case"
  individuals: [CaseIndividual!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The list of entities in this case"
  entities: [CaseEntity!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Entity and individual relationships for this case"
  entityStructure: EntityStructure! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The urls to First AML applications for the case"
  urls: CaseUrls! @cost(weight: "10")
  riskAssessmentSubmission: RiskSubmission @cost(weight: "10")
  "The users assigned to the case"
  assignedUsers: [User!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The pdf documents associated with the case"
  pdfs: [GeneratedPdfInformation!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The verification type for this case"
  individualVerificationType: IndividualVerificationType! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The tags applied to this case"
  tags: [TagDefinition!]! @cost(weight: "10")
  dueDate: Date
  "The calculated disbursement for this case. Null if disbursements are not enabled or no disbursement has been calculated yet."
  disbursement: CaseDisbursementSummary @cost(weight: "10")
}

type CaseUrls {
  "The url to view the details for this case"
  view: URL!
  "The url to complete the case creation process for this case"
  complete: URL!
}

type ContactInfo {
  fullName: String
  emailAddress: String
}

"Describes a controlling interest relationship between two entities"
type ControllingEntityRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the entity in the relationship"
  entityId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Unique identifier of the parent entity in the relationship"
  parentEntityId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Represents details about the nature of control"
  significantControlDetails: SignificantControlDetails
}

"Describes an individuals controlling relationship in an entity"
type ControllingIndividualEntityRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the entity in the relationship"
  entityId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Unique identifier of the individual in the relationship"
  individualId: String! @cost(weight: "10")
  "Type of controlling relationship"
  controllingRelationshipType: ControllingRelationshipType
  "Represents details about the nature of control"
  significantControlDetails: SignificantControlDetails
}

"Identifying information for a country"
type CountryInformation {
  CCA2: String!
}

type CustomDomainSecurityTimelineItem implements SecurityTimelineItem {
  actor: Actor @cost(weight: "10")
  domainIdentifier: String!
  sendingStatus: CustomDomainSendingStatus
  type: SecurityTimelineItemType!
  timestamp: DateTime!
  ipAddress: String
}

type DateRiskSubmissionAnswer implements ScoredRiskSubmissionAnswer & RiskSubmissionAnswer {
  question(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String!
  comment(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String
  notApplicable: Boolean
  date: Date
  score: Int
}

type DocumentField {
  name: String!
  value: String
  type: DocumentFieldType!
}

"Details of a document"
type DocumentInformation {
  "Unique identifier for the document"
  documentId: String! @deprecated(reason: "Please use documentId on the parent object")
  "The id for the file"
  fileId: String
  "File extension (including leading period '.')"
  fileExtension: String
  "Title of the file (without file extension"
  fileTitle: String!
  "Url of the document contents to retrieve via GET request (requires authentication)"
  contentsUrl: URL
}

type DomesticPepScreeningSource implements ScreeningSource {
  "The name of the source"
  name: String!
  "The types and subtypes of the PEP match"
  types: [String!]!
  "The country codes associated with the PEP match"
  countryCodes: [String!]!
  "Source URL"
  url: String
  "The date when the PEP listing started"
  startedDate: Date
  "The date when the PEP listing ended"
  endedDate: Date
  "Additional data specific to PEP screening sources"
  additionalData: PepScreeningAdditionalData!
}

type EmailRiskSubmissionAnswer implements ScoredRiskSubmissionAnswer & RiskSubmissionAnswer {
  question(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String!
  comment(includeHtml: Boolean! = true): String
  notApplicable: Boolean
  email: String
  score: Int
}

"Represents a controlling relationship between two entities"
type EntityControllingRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the entity being controlled in the relationship"
  entityId: String!
  "Unique identifier of the controlling entity in the relationship"
  controllingEntityId: String!
  controlType: EntityControlType!
  significantControlDetails: SignificantControlDetails
}

type EntityDocumentInformation {
  "Type of the document"
  type: EntityDocumentType!
  "The individual files that support this document"
  files: [DocumentInformation!]!
  "Unique identifier for the document"
  documentId: String!
  "The fields related to the specific document type (if any)"
  fields: [DocumentField!]!
  title: String!
}

type EntityDocumentSecurityTimelineItem implements SecurityTimelineItem {
  actor: Actor @cost(weight: "10")
  documentId: String
  entityId: String!
  caseId: String!
  type: SecurityTimelineItemType!
  accessMethod: DocumentAccessMethod
  timestamp: DateTime!
  ipAddress: String
}

type EntityExceptionDetails {
  "The reason given for adding the exception"
  reason: String!
  "The user display name who added the exception into the platform"
  addedByDisplayName: String
  "The client full name who approved of adding the exception"
  approvedByFullName: String
  "To indicate whether the exception has supporting documents or not"
  hasSupportingDocuments: Boolean!
  "The date time the exception was created on."
  createdOn: DateTime!
  "The date time the exception was updated on."
  updatedOn: DateTime!
  "Type of exception"
  exceptionType: ExceptionType!
  "Whether the exception is resolved or not"
  isResolved: Boolean!
  "The user display name who resolved the exception"
  resolvedByName: String
}

"Represents an involvement relationship between two entities"
type EntityInvolvedRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the primary entity in the involvement relationship"
  entityId: String!
  "Unique identifier of the involved entity in the relationship"
  involvedEntityId: String!
  role: EntityInvolvementRole!
}

"Describes an entity that is the root of the entity structure within a case"
type EntityRootRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the root entity"
  rootEntityId: String!
}

"Represents a shareholding relationship where one entity holds shares in another entity"
type EntityShareholdingRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the entity whose shares are held"
  entityId: String!
  "Unique identifier of the entity holding shares in another entity"
  shareholdingEntityId: String!
  "Represents a share class associated with a shareholding relationship"
  shareClass: ShareClass!
  percentShareholding: Decimal
  shareNumber: Long
  beneficiallyHeld: Boolean
}

type EntityStructure {
  entityRelationships: [EntityRelationship!]! @cost(weight: "10") @deprecated(reason: "Use relationships field instead, which provides all relationship types and share classes.")
  "The relationships this individual has to the entities in this case"
  individualEntityRelationships: [IndividualEntityRelationship!]! @cost(weight: "10") @deprecated(reason: "Use relationships field instead, which provides all relationship types and share classes.")
  relationships: [EntityStructureRelationship!]! @cost(weight: "10")
}

type EntityUrls {
  "The url to view the details for this case"
  view: URL!
  "The url to view the entity's profile"
  profile: URL! @cost(weight: "10")
}

type EntityVerificationReport {
  "Result of sanctions checks for the entity"
  sanctions: ScreeningResult!
  "Result of warning checks for the entity"
  warning: ScreeningResult!
  "Result of fitness and probity checks for the entity"
  fitnessProbity: ScreeningResult!
  "Result of adverse media checks for the entity"
  adverseMedia: ScreeningResult!
  "When the verification report was generated"
  generatedOn: DateTime!
  "The reviewed true match screening review hits associated with this entity verification report"
  screeningReviewHits: ScreeningReviewHitsResults! @cost(weight: "10")
}

type EntityVerificationStatus {
  overall: VerificationStatus!
  sanctions: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  warning: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  fitnessProbity: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  adverseMedia: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  dateVerified: DateTime @cost(weight: "10")
}

type FitnessAndProbityScreeningAdditionalData {
  "Addresses associated with the fitness and probity issue"
  addresses: [String!]!
  "Activation dates"
  activationDates: [String!]!
  "Enforcement agencies"
  enforcementAgencies: [String!]!
  "Registration numbers of the fitness and probity issue"
  registrationNumbers: [String!]!
  "Other relevant information"
  otherInfo: [String!]!
}

type FitnessAndProbityScreeningSource implements ScreeningSource {
  "The name of the source"
  name: String!
  "The types and subtypes of the fitness and probity issue"
  types: [String!]!
  "The country codes associated with the fitness and probity issue"
  countryCodes: [String!]!
  "Source URL"
  url: String
  "The date when the fitness and probity issue started"
  startedDate: Date
  "The date when the fitness and probity issue ended"
  endedDate: Date
  "Additional data specific to fitness and probity screening sources"
  additionalData: FitnessAndProbityScreeningAdditionalData!
}

type ForeignPepScreeningSource implements ScreeningSource {
  "The name of the source"
  name: String!
  "The types and subtypes of the PEP match"
  types: [String!]!
  "The country codes associated with the PEP match"
  countryCodes: [String!]!
  "Source URL"
  url: String
  "The date when the PEP listing started"
  startedDate: Date
  "The date when the PEP listing ended"
  endedDate: Date
  "Additional data specific to PEP screening sources"
  additionalData: PepScreeningAdditionalData!
}

type GeneratedPdfInformation {
  status: GeneratedPdfStatus!
  id: Int!
  url: String
  type: PdfType!
}

type IndividualDocumentFile {
  "The file id"
  fileId: String!
  "The type of document file e.g. front or back image of a drivers license"
  fileType: IndividualDocumentFileType!
  "Unique identifier for the document"
  documentId: String! @deprecated(reason: "Please use documentId on IndividualDocumentInformation")
  "File extension (including leading period '.')"
  fileExtension: String!
  "Title of the file (without file extension"
  fileTitle: String!
  "Url of the document contents to retrieve via GET request (requires authentication)"
  contentsUrl: URL!
}

type IndividualDocumentInformation {
  "Unique identifier for the document"
  documentId: String!
  "Title of the document"
  title: String!
  "Type of the document"
  type: IndividualDocumentType!
  "Country of origin for the individual document"
  country: CountryInformation
  "Regional variant of a document e.g. short-form State code in Australia"
  regionalVariant: String
  "Country of issue for the individual document - not currently populated"
  countryOfIssue: CountryInformation
  "The individual files that support this document - may include front and back-side images of a card for instance"
  files: [IndividualDocumentFile!]!
  "Identity number from the document (passport or drivers license number for instance)"
  number: String
  "The expiration date of the document"
  expiryDate: Date
  "The version number of the document (if present on the drivers license or identity card etc.)"
  versionNumber: String
  "The gender reported on the identity document (if any)"
  gender: Gender
  "The fields related to the specific document type (if any)"
  fields: [DocumentField!]!
}

type IndividualDocumentSecurityTimelineItem implements SecurityTimelineItem {
  actor: Actor @cost(weight: "10")
  documentId: String
  individualId: String!
  caseId: String!
  type: SecurityTimelineItemType!
  accessMethod: DocumentAccessMethod
  timestamp: DateTime!
  ipAddress: String
}

"Represents a beneficial ownership relationship between an individual and an entity"
type IndividualEntityBeneficialOwnerRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the entity for which the individual is a beneficial owner"
  entityId: String!
  "Unique identifier of the beneficial owner individual in the relationship"
  beneficialOwnerIndividualId: String!
  "Indicates the nature of the individual's beneficial ownership, such as ownership of shares or voting rights"
  nature: BeneficialOwnerNature!
  "Specifies the source of the beneficial ownership information"
  source: BeneficialOwnerSource!
  ownershipPercentage: Decimal
}

"Represents a controlling relationship between an individual and an entity"
type IndividualEntityControllingRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the entity being controlled in the relationship"
  entityId: String!
  "Unique identifier of the controlling individual in the relationship"
  controllingIndividualId: String!
  controlType: EntityControlType!
  significantControlDetails: SignificantControlDetails
}

"Represents an involvement relationship between an individual and an entity"
type IndividualEntityInvolvedRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the primary entity in the involvement relationship"
  entityId: String!
  "Unique identifier of the involved individual in the relationship"
  involvedIndividualId: String!
  role: IndividualInvolvementRole!
}

"Represents a shareholding relationship where an individual holds shares in an entity"
type IndividualEntityShareholdingRelationship {
  "Unique identifier of the entity whose shares are held"
  entityId: String!
  "Unique identifier of the individual holding shares in the entity"
  shareholdingIndividualId: String!
  "Represents a share class associated with a shareholding relationship"
  shareClass: ShareClass!
  percentShareholding: Decimal
  shareNumber: Long
}

type IndividualExceptionDetails {
  "The reason given for adding the exception"
  reason: String!
  "The user display name who added the exception into the platform"
  addedByDisplayName: String
  "The client full name who approved of adding the exception"
  approvedByFullName: String
  "To indicate whether the exception has supporting documents or not"
  hasSupportingDocuments: Boolean!
  "The date time the exception was created on."
  createdOn: DateTime!
  "The date time the exception was updated on."
  updatedOn: DateTime!
  "Type of exception"
  exceptionType: ExceptionType!
  "Whether the exception is resolved or not"
  isResolved: Boolean!
  "The user display name who resolved the exception"
  resolvedByName: String
}

type IndividualUrls {
  "The url to verify the individual for this case"
  verification(embedded: Boolean! = false): UrlResultType! @cost(weight: "10")
  "The url to view the individual for this case"
  view: URL!
  "The url to view the individual's profile"
  profile: URL! @cost(weight: "10")
}

type IndividualVerificationCheckQueued {
  individual: CaseIndividual!
  verificationChecks: [IndividualVerificationCheck!]!
}

type IndividualVerificationCheckStatus {
  legalName: VerificationStatus!
  dateOfBirth: VerificationStatus!
  address: VerificationStatus!
  pep: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10") @deprecated(reason: "Please use domesticPep, foreignPep or otherPep instead.")
  otherPep: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  domesticPep: ScreeningStatus @cost(weight: "10")
  foreignPep: ScreeningStatus @cost(weight: "10")
  sanctions: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  warning: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  fitnessProbity: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  adverseMedia: ScreeningStatus! @cost(weight: "10")
  biometric: VerificationStatus!
  antiTampering: VerificationStatus!
  idValidity: VerificationStatus!
  governmentId: VerificationStatus!
  overall: VerificationStatus!
  dateVerified: DateTime
}

type IndividualVerificationReport {
  "Results of checks against the individuals full name"
  fullName: VerificationResult!
  "Results of checks against the individuals date of birth"
  dateOfBrith: VerificationResult! @deprecated(reason: "Use dateOfBirth instead")
  "Results of checks against the individuals date of birth"
  dateOfBirth: VerificationResult!
  "Results of the Government ID check for the individual"
  governmentId: VerificationResult!
  "Results of checks against the individuals address"
  address: VerificationResult!
  "Results of the anti-tampering checks for the individual"
  antiTampering: DocumentVerificationResult!
  "Results of the ID validity check for the individual"
  idValidity: DocumentVerificationResult!
